verdict.rationale: Quo is an API-backed communications platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question, but the pack documents none. The OpenAPI spec lists only a production server, the docs' "Try it" playground runs against the production API with a real key, and every API key grants full API access. The 7-day free trial is not an isolated test environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
